title: NEV upgrades boon for steel industry
dek: China Daily reports that upgrades in new energy vehicles are a boon for the steel industry.
summary: According to a China Daily Global Edition headline, upgrades to new energy vehicles (NEVs) are a boon for the steel industry. The publisher's excerpt is empty and gives no detail on the grades, volumes or companies involved.
whyItMatters: Growing NEV production could lift demand for higher-value automotive and electrical steels. Such demand may partly offset weakness in other end-use sectors.
implications: Producers of advanced automotive and electrical steel grades may find opportunities. The material does not quantify the demand.
